core_obligations: Forward: on D_+(fg) with deg(f) = deg(g) + d the element (f/g)^n generates O_X(dn), so D_+(fg) sits inside W_d.
Converse: if O_X(dn) is free with compatible multiplications near x, pick D_+(h) inside V, extract a generator s of (S_h)_d, write s = f/g, and clear denominators to force x into D_+(f).
The same generating sections imply the module multiplication maps M-tilde(nd) to M(nd)-tilde are isomorphisms over W_d.
proof_roadmap: Prove the forward inclusion by displaying the generators, then the converse by writing the generator as a fraction and clearing denominators, and close by mirroring the module step.
difficulty_reason: Explicit generating sections (f/g)^n on charts plus a converse constructing the chart from a generating section; the module-multiplication step mirrors the trivialization card.
